description: Start widget and call overlay: read projects (with the brief state and the overview, projects_overview), people and calls; start and run a call; drag and hide; hand over to another window (windows_show); read whether another app uses the microphone (mic_activity_get); refresh an outdated brief in the background before a call (brief_prepare); read, start, finish, resume the call in progress and stop its countdown (call_current, call_start, call_finish, call_resume, call_keep; the summary closes it in the main window); start, stop and watch the recording (recording_*); read the transcript (transcript_*); read the call's questions and topics, act on a question and retry the agent (call_state_get, questions_act, agent_retry). No project, document, people or settings changes.
